question: IVF-PQ index build time overhead vs flat index

sources.title: Accelerating Vector Search: NVIDIA cuVS IVF-PQ Part 1, Deep Dive
sources.snippet: Building an IVF-PQ index involves the same k-means clustering step as an IVF-Flat index. In addition, IVF-PQ must train the sub-quantizers, which makes the index building time take considerably longer.
